Acme Code — Developer-first SAST

Acme Code is the developer-first SAST tool that runs in your IDE and pull request pipeline. It uses the hybrid DeepCheck AI engine to detect vulnerabilities with low false-positive rates.

Developers get instant feedback in their editor; security teams get coverage dashboards and policy enforcement through Acme AppRisk. The platform integrates with GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps, and your CI of choice.

Acme Code is part of the broader Acme developer security platform that also includes Acme Deps for SCA, Acme Container for image scanning, Acme IaC for infrastructure configuration, and Acme AI Trust Platform for AISPM.
